Name: Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings for SVE
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=3][center][font=Comic Sans MS][/font][/center][left][center][font=Comic Sans MS]This is a CP retexture for new farm buildings added in SVE (Barn, Coop and Winery) to match the style of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/494]Ali's Overgrown Fairy Buildings mod[/url]﻿.

Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155]strawberrymilk95[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] for giving permission to create this mod!
[/font][/center][font=Comic Sans MS][center]---------------------------[/center]
[b][color=#d9ead3]Config:[/color][/b]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Premium Coop - true/false[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Premium Barn - true/false[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Winery - true/false[/size][/font]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3]Winter Look -  true/false (adds or removes flower wines during winter.[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b][color=#d9ead3]Installation:[/color][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿, [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded.[/url]﻿
[*]Unzip [i]"[CP] Overgrown Fairy Buildings for SVE" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
[*]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.
[*]Have fun!
[/list][/font][center][font=Comic Sans MS]
-----------------------------------------[/font][/center][url=https://hipolink.me/simonk112][/url][/left][/size]
